title: Grateful Dead Live at Baton Rouge Int. Speedway on 1969-09-01
lineage: SBD > MC (Ampex C-90 cassette) > DAT > CD-R

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary 1969 outdoor set, highlighted by an epic Easy Wind and soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers impressively clear, upgraded soundboard quality for this early‑'69 festival show, preserving the band’s loose, funk‑infused vibe. Reviewers rave about the standout performances of Easy Wind, Casey Jones, Morning Dew and a blazing Dark Star, while noting lively stage banter that adds historic flavor.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews rate the show 4‑5 stars and praise both musical performance and sound quality; only one low rating appears, yielding a strong overall positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, impressive sound for an old outdoor show; upgraded mix adds ambience, clear instrument separation. Some edits removed stage banter but no major audio defects reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A loose, funk‑laden performance typical of 1969 festival dates; the band stretches into extended jams (Dark Star→St. Stephen→Eleven) while keeping a relaxed, energetic vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar on Casey Jones is praised; one reviewer hears a subtle Proud Mary hint in the opening minute.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for humorous stage banter (the “Godammit!” exchange) and strong vocal presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ appears on Dark Star (and possibly Easy Wind); Pigpen’s bluesy vocals are highlighted on Easy Wind.
